# nuke-di

> The simplest dependency injection for async Python projects.

Before writing code with nuke-di, know what it deliberately lacks. A dependency is a `Client` subclass with a
type-hinted `__init__` and async `connect()` / `disconnect()`; the type hint is the only registration. There are no
provider or factory functions (ADR-0005), no binding of a Protocol to an implementation, qualifiers or multibinding
(ADR-0008), no per-request or per-message scopes (ADR-0006) and no retries in `connect()` (ADR-0009): the
recipes in the guide reach the same results with plain clients, `mock()` and `override()`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/README.md): the pitch, the Quick start, the principles and two examples
- [Clients](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/clients.md): `Client` and `NotSingletonClient`, the lifecycle, dataclass clients, connect order, startup timings, the dependency graph, connect and resolution errors
- [The container](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/container.md): `Dependencies` and the global `DI`, `resolve()`, `inject()`, `mock()`, `override()`
- [Workers and jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/workers-and-jobs.md): `@job` and `@worker`, command-line parameters, `Shutdown`, the grace period, background tasks, exit codes, hooks, Kubernetes
- [FastAPI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/fastapi.md)
- [Litestar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/litestar.md)
- [FastStream](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/faststream.md)
- [MCP servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/mcp.md)
- [aiogram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/aiogram.md)
- [Writing an integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/integrations.md)
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/testing.md): `mock()`, `override()`, the pytest fixtures, checking the wiring
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/configuration.md): timeouts, concurrency and the grace period
- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/errors.md): every exception and when it is raised
- [Coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/agents.md): the Agent Skill, a block for `AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`, Context7, the graph as JSON
- [Development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/troyan-dy/nuke-di/master/docs/guide/development.md): the checks, coverage and releases
